name: delimiter breakout
closed_by: per-call nonce in the isolation tag; the wrapper does not terminate on a guessed tag
residual_risk: none for this bypass. The payload cannot learn the nonce, and a document that guessed it would stay inside the block.

name: score laundering
layer_defeated: capability ceiling (layer 3) - by design, not by defect
closed_by: UNTRUSTED_VALUE_PROVENANCE: a judgement argument that appears verbatim in the untrusted text is refused, while the same tool with an agent-computed value still succeeds
residual_risk: the check is a substring test. A payload that encodes the number obfuscated, or instructs the agent in prose rather than supplying a literal, would not match it. The capability ceiling still holds, so the blast radius stays at one internal, reversible field.

name: confirmation token as an accidental baseline control
closed_by: the undefended arm now grants a confirmation token, so 'unguarded' means no controls rather than 'every control except one'
residual_risk: none, but it is the reason this project's baseline is 0.87 and not the 0.53 an earlier version reported.
